FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about hiring developers and designers through ntech.

FAQcard.title: How quickly can your team start on my project?
FAQcard.description: Our team can typically begin within 48–72 hours of finalizing the agreement. We maintain a pool of pre-vetted developers and designers ready to start immediately.

FAQcard.title: What technologies does your team specialize in?
FAQcard.description: Our team covers React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PHP, Unity game development, Figma design, WordPress, Shopify, and more. We match the right specialists to your project.

FAQcard.title: Do you handle both design and development?
FAQcard.description: Yes. We're a full-service digital agency with dedicated designers, developers, SEO specialists, and IT engineers working together to deliver complete solutions.

FAQcard.title: How do you ensure quality?
FAQcard.description: We follow rigorous code review processes, QA testing, and design feedback loops. All work goes through internal quality checks before delivery.

FAQcard.title: Can I hire for a short-term project?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We offer flexible engagements from a few hours of consulting to full-time dedicated teams. Scale up or down based on your project needs at any time.

FAQcard.title: What is the cost to hire a developer or designer?
FAQcard.description: Pricing varies based on skill level, specialization, and engagement model. Contact us for a detailed quote tailored to your specific requirements and timeline.
